intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Reliable support with quiet sophistication
features.text: Made from high-grade engineered wood, our bed is strong and stable — designed to complement your room with calm confidence and lasting strength.

features.title: Hydraulic storage that lifts with ease
features.text: A gentle lift opens up generous hidden storage — no strain, no clutter, just simple access to the things you need, when you need them. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Lean back and let go
features.text: The cushioned headboard is crafted for comfort — offering you the soft support you need to stretch, read, or simply relax in peace.

features.title: Natural textures that invite calm
features.text: The textured matte wood finish gives your space a soft, grounded feel — a quiet detail that makes a big difference.

features.title: Headboard storage with thoughtful detail
features.text: Built-in shelving and an extra ledge offer a beautiful way to keep your everyday items close — organised, accessible, and always within reach.

name: Upmods Lattice Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
